text: Dre. Why is my jacket on your table?
That's not your jacket. That's inventory.
Inventory?
I started a business. Pre-owned clothing. It's called Dre's Closet.
It's my closet! That's my jacket! It's got my name tag on it!
A lot of people named Skip.
Name one other Skip.
I'm not gonna give out my customers' information.
Give me my jacket.
For you? Thirty five dollars. Friends and family price.
You want me to BUY my own jacket?
Normally it's forty. That's a five dollar discount, Skip.
Where did you even get it?
Lost and found.
I didn't lose it! I hung it on the hook! Yesterday!
Hook's in the hallway. Hallway's basically lost and found.
That's not how hallways work!
Look, I got other items. You like this lunch box?
That's my lunch box!
Comes with a free napkin.
My mama wrote on that napkin!
Adds character. Collectors love that.
Okay. You know what? I'll take the jacket.
Good choice. Cash App or Zelle?
Take it out of the forty dollars you owe me.
Oh. So you want store credit.
I want my forty dollars!
Now you owe ME five dollars. Business is business.
How do I owe you?!
Jacket's thirty five. Debt's forty. Plus five dollar shipping.
Shipping?! You're standing right here!
I'm walking it over. That's my legs, Skip.
